actual_scope: Repair environment-dependent replay-input spelling using exact HEAD identity at both shared boundaries, with deletion and case-only-rename controls.
scope_change_reason: Take PR2994's live exact-Git-spelling handoff instead of the drawn canonical-payload audit method. Filesystem alias acceptance can omit proof-relevant replays even on case-sensitive CI; this is verifier reliability, not a supplier improvement.
bottleneck_link: Prevents declared proof-relevant dependencies from silently escaping exact Git-diff invalidation. No exponent or supplier-cost change is claimed.
stop_rule: One shared identity contract and source-bound baseline/candidate CLI replay, nine regression groups, relevant tooling checks and a focused PR. Stop before generic alias equivalence, native platform provisioning or any supplier replay.
evidence: verify.py reproduces three exact-main omissions and three repaired rejections against target-only Git commits. tests/test_research_git_spelling.py checks metadata, planning, Unicode, removals, case-only renames, unusual filenames, staged/untracked inputs and no partial output.
author: Nick Petalas
ai_assistance: The named contributor is responsible for the implementation and verification. No independent human review is claimed.
